sn_bcm_document.default_text: This plan addresses the components necessary for a viable BCP/DRP. The elements addressed reflect the restoration of "Tier 1: Mission-Critical", "Tier 2: BusinessCritical," and "Tier 3: Important" business operations and those functions necessary to accomplish this task through integrated coordination of available resources. Tier 1- 3 business operations require recovery in less than 72 hours. "Tier 4: Supportive" and "Tier 5: Non-Essential" business operations require recovery from 72 hours to 30 days. This plan addresses the PCFS business operations at the following PCFS business location(s): – [insert address(es) of PCFS site performing the relevant business processes covered by this plan]
sn_bcm_document.description: The plan scope describes an overview of the BCP/DRP's purpose and coverage areas. The scope is a key component used to demonstrate compliance.
